decision.rationale: TXN-008050 is a 17.44 EUR charge by Ironbridge Audio on card CRD-000097. It was made on 2026-08-31 and posted on 2026-09-01. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 59 days after posting, so it is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000055, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-04. That is after the charge on 2026-08-31. The charge therefore covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled, and policy recurring-cancelled-after-charge says to decline.

proposed_actions.reason: Ironbridge Audio confirmed in writing that your subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-04. The 17.44 EUR charge was made on 2026-08-31, before that date, so it is for a period that had not yet been cancelled.
